inputs.title: Improve touch screen, operation
inputs.description: Address the reported customer difficulties and unmet needs involving touch screen, operation. Confirm the affected configurations and the intended behavior with the PM before engineering assessment.
inputs.sample_policy: First eight distinct eligible records by sorted evidence ID; not a representative statistical sample.

evidence.text: Customer stated he is having trouble getting used to the advanced computer systems and touchpad controls during the first couple of weeks of ownership. Writer offered assistance, but customer replied that he simply needs a bit more time with the vehicle.
I had a serious problem with Touchscreen/display screen - DTU: "There are a lot of options, so I had to dig through menus to locate stuff. Putting items into presets makes it easier."

for me and my husband, who does most of the driving, the biggest negative is having nearly all the controls on the touch screen. we just can't remember every symbol for everything. a lot of them we still don't recognize and feel like we need to go back to see a genius again. we are also worried that there are no more run flat tires. we still haven't figured out how the tire flat inflator actually works. the sport vs regular gearing feels too far apart. in normal drive, the a/c airflow gets too low whenever we sit in traffic or at a red light, which is hard to deal with in southern florida where it's always hot. on the plus side, the outside and inside look very beautiful. the seats are very comfortable, but we miss having the back seat pockets and spots to store things.
the way it drives is very smooth and comfortable.
I had a minor problem with Touchscreen/display screen - DTU: "The touchscreen interface feels somewhat clumsy, and the layout could definitely be arranged in a better way."
Customer states certain parts of the touch screen respond slowly when changing to the next screen.
I had a minor problem with Touchscreen/display screen - Difficult to see/glare/gets dirty: "it picks up smudges really quickly so I have to wipe it down all the time."

my two main issues - hvac really needs physical knobs, period. having to dig three layers into a screen while driving is not just annoying, it's stupid and unsafe. and why even put in a sunroof if you restrict it to opening no more than halfway? this is my fourth bmw and at around $78k, i'm honestly regreting it.

I had a problem with Touchscreen/display screen - DTU: "To start with, it becomes extremely hot to the touch. The big issue is there are just too many options. Nothing else really worsens it, it's simply a lot to learn."

output.title: Improve touch screen operation usability and responsiveness
output.description: Enhance the touch screen interface of the G60 model vehicles to reduce user difficulty, improve responsiveness, and simplify accessing key controls. Ensure the menu structure is intuitive and common functions are easily reachable without multiple navigation layers, prioritizing safety and user comfort.
acceptance_criteria: The touch screen interface layout is optimized to reduce complexity and improve ease of use.
Touch screen responsiveness is improved to eliminate slow transitions between screens.
Commonly used functions, especially HVAC controls, are accessible with minimal navigation or alternative physical controls are considered.
The system provides clear, easily recognizable symbols and presets for frequent functions.
Efforts are made to reduce smudges and glare on the touch screen surface or suggest appropriate cleanability improvements.
uncertainties: The exact configurations affected by the slow touch screen response are not specified.
The balance between touch screen and physical controls (e.g., for HVAC) needs validation with broader customer feedback.
The impact of environmental factors on screen smudging and glare is not precisely quantified.

aspects.explanation: Strong user request for physical HVAC controls to improve safety and ease of in-vehicle adjustments.
